4. Earlier also, a writ petition for the same relief filed by the petitioner was dismissed as having become infructuous vide order dated 17.08.2022 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. 10731 of 2022, which is quoted as under:

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. 10731 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
Present writ petition has been preferred for a direction to the respondents to investigate the Case Crime No.782 of 2020 under Section 420, 406, 467, 468, 471,
379 IPC, P.S. Kotwali, Distt. Moradabad fairly and impartially.

On the matter being taken up today, learned AGA on the basis of instructions apprises to the Court that in the present matter Final Report dated 19.10.2021 has already been forwarded to the competent court and as such the reliefs claimed in the writ petition no more survives.
In view of above, the writ petition is dismissed as having become infructuous."
5.
As per annexure-SA-2 of the supplementary affidavit, twice final report has been submitted and the objections were raised by the Joint Director, Prosecution on 12.01.2023 on the last final report.

It appears that the petitioner has prayed the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Moradabad under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. and the notices have been issued to the Police Officer / Circle Officer fixing the date 9.08.2023.
6.

In view of the above, we are of the considered opinion that alternative remedy is available to the petitioner under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C., which has already been availed by the the petitioner and therefore, the present petition, which is also second petition for the same relief, is not maintainable for the relief so prayed..
7. The petitioner is at liberty to avail the remedy available in accordance with law 8.
With the aforesaid observations, the writ petition is disposed of.

Order Date :- 19.9.2023 Ashish Pd.
